svg.aria-label: Equality Engine at a glance. The problem: bias creeps into every stage of a hiring algorithm, from the state of the world (historical bias) to the sample (representation), dataset (measurement), algorithms (modeling), and job applications (deployment). The game: two players act as engineers who debug it together over three rounds of Discover Bias, Debias, and Take Actions. The outcome: students' median self-reported knowledge of ML bias rose from 16.5 to 24 out of 28 after one session.
